{"concepts_used":["GC-0099","GC-0089"],"decline_reason":"","declined":false,"citations":[{"ref":"TMM/Part24/2#1~2","quote":"Entry in the Register will make it clear the disclaimer is voluntary and to that end will be prefaced by the words: The following disclaimer has been requested under subsection 74(1): This will differentiate such disclaimers from the compulsory disclaimers imposed under the repealed legislation."},{"ref":"TMA1995/s74","quote":"(3) The Registrar must, on registering the trade mark or on receiving notice of the disclaimer (whichever is later), enter the particulars of the disclaimer in the Register."}],"answer":"Manual practice: the Register entry will identify the disclaimer as voluntary by prefacing it with the exact words:

“The following disclaimer has been requested under subsection 74(1):”

This distinguishes it from compulsory disclaimers imposed under the repealed legislation (TMM/Part24/2#1~2).

Act: subsection 74(3) requires the Registrar to enter the disclaimer’s particulars in the Register. The quoted prefatory wording is Manual practice, not wording prescribed by that subsection (TMA1995/s74)."}
